title: Stale evidence - planned-withdrawal data older than policy allows; blocked until refreshed
scenarioRefNote: Maps to scenarios.yaml `stale-evidence` (material evidence is older than policy allows; blocked until a fresh snapshot resolves it). Exercises v3 invariant 11: present-but-stale evidence cannot silently proceed - validate is distinct from evaluate.

signoff.note: Expected outcomes are product truth subject to captain signoff. Draft sets the staleness rule at the policy level (planned-withdrawal evidence must be under 30 days old for a reserve computation); the captain confirms the freshness window archetype. Captain reapproved the explicit evidence-completeness matrix and canonical UTC timestamps on 2026-07-28.

trigger.description: Advisor enters the $75,000 request; the planned-withdrawal schedule was last observed 47 days ago and the reserve computation depends on it.
trigger.maskedRequestSummary: distribute 75000 USD; reserve-material evidence exceeds its freshness window (tokenized)

householdEvidence.summary: Balance evidence is fresh - staleness is isolated to the planned-withdrawal schedule.

Planned-withdrawal schedule last observed 2026-06-09 (47 days before asOf) - outside the 30-day freshness window firm policy requires for reserve-material evidence. Observed time and retrieved time are shown separately.

householdInstructions.summary: Source preference noted; a source cannot be committed while the reserve arithmetic rests on stale data.

expectedAuthority.note: A blocked decision carries no authority and no execution plan (v3 invariant 8). Approving a reserve computed from stale data would be exactly the silent-proceed v3 invariant 11 forbids.

expectedExecutionEligibility.reason: The cash-reserve computation is material to the decision and its planned-withdrawal input exceeds the 30-day freshness window.

blockers.explanation: Planned-withdrawal evidence is 47 days old; policy requires under 30 days for reserve-material computations.

expectedExplanationNodes.summary: The planned-withdrawal snapshot (observed 2026-06-09) exceeds the 30-day window; the evidence view shows observed vs retrieved time and the stale badge - no unexplained confidence score anywhere.
The evidence EXISTS but is not fresh enough to compute the reserve - validation fails before evaluation, and the resolving affordance is a refresh request, not an override.

expectedLedgerEvents.note: The stale planned-withdrawal snapshot is recorded with freshness 'stale' - staleness is provenance, not an omission.
Blocked decision recording the stale-evidence blocker and the refresh path; no authority, no execution plan.

expectedVerificationState.note: No execution occurs. A fresh planned-withdrawal snapshot resolves the block and evaluation re-runs on a NEW input bundle - the stale bundle is never patched in place.
